find: return raw === '' ? { commit: '', known: false } : { commit: raw, known: true };
killedBy: readBuildIdentity says unknown rather than inventing a version reports an absent variable as unknown, not as an empty commit
readBuildIdentity says unknown rather than inventing a version treats an empty or whitespace value as absent
formatDiagnostics says a local build is unknown, in words
why: Calls every build known, including the ones that are not. Issue #247 requires copied diagnostics to "identify local/unknown builds honestly", and this is the dishonest version: a dev server, a local build and any tree that never went through the deploy workflow all report `known: true` with an empty commit, so the report prints a Build line with nothing after it. A reader takes that for a formatting bug and assumes the build IS identified -- which is worse than saying unknown, because it removes the prompt to go and find out.
